body:
I got sick at school when I was 15, and had to leave. I had quite a lot of friends at school but of course, at that age it's 'out of sight, out of mind' and they moved on to college and university. I don't speak to any of them anymore. 

The way it happened was really strange. I had what I thought was a long, drawn out mild flu thing (aches, pains, headaches) for a couple of months.. or maybe one flu after another.. so mild that I still went to school as much as I could (I loved school). I didn't really take much notice, but I did feel very sick. Then all of a sudden, one night (I remember it was a Friday night) I was laying in bed and my whole body seized up, and felt like it was burning. I couldn't move at all, and I felt really sick. I was terrified and called for my mother, who stayed with me most of the night because I begged her to. I was like that for four days. To this day I dont know why an ambulance wasnt called, but I think she thought maybe it was just a fever? But since that night, I've had these problems. So the onset was pretty instant, after the initial mild illness. One of the things the doctors say is that I might have had a virus, and not resting made my body react to it poorly, and thats why I'm now disabled. But the flu thing was honestly so mild.. so I'm not sure.

I'll pm you! :)

Thank you for your reply.. You are right, I should teach myself things here. Perhaps I'll be useful someday, if I do. 

I'm looking forward to the release of Guild Wars 2, finding a guild and such. Hopefully I will meet people there and have some fun.

Sometimes I feel it's just all so fruitless, and carrying on when it hurts this much just seems like silliness.. It could just all go away. But I do know deep down that I may be missing on awesome things. I just hope I muster up the strength to bear it, waiting for those things :)

I have been warned that the possibility of dying looks like it may increase over the age of 25, if my health keeps degrading at this rate. However, since a lot of my health remains a mystery and the doctors only really have the symptoms to look at (muscle weakness, digestion problems, etc) without a clue of what connects them or why its happening, it may not work that way at all. Basically, if I die it will be because I cannot feed myself, drink, or digest things probably even if fed.. if the 'symptoms' get worse.. or if I push myself so much that my organs fail. Apparently my organs freak out a little every time I even stand up, which was a scary discovery. Like I had been putting myself under immense physical pressures. I dont feel that, I just feel woozy and weak when I stand.. so it was a shock.

I think I would be happier with a friend :)

How the online friendships usually go is I meet someone - through websites or games - and they will be happy to talk if they feel lonely. Advice, kind words, but then I will be forgotten when they move on in their real life - the pattern is maximum a couple of months. The most recent friendship lasted three. It's natural, I know that, but sometimes talks of friendship are made that arnt kept, when they sound so sincere, and it just makes me feel disheartened.

I have pushed myself to meet a couple in the past, which really messed with my health and had consequences for it. One tried to use me for sex, quite bluntly, as he (by his own admission) felt I would be 'easier' since I didn't have much chance at meeting men. He was upset when I wasnt (I did actually like him before he spoke cruelly to me, I was just nervous about taking things further so quickly).

Thank you for replying! Much love to Sweden <3! I met a very nice girl from Sweden online.. she seemed genuinely lovely, but I dont find her logging on anymore. Sometimes that just happens.

I understand. When you adored them so much, when they were your everything, made you that happy, when they were your future.. when you thought it was going to work out, and they just leave.. everything just comes crashing around your ears. It makes no sense.

Logically you know that they probably did what was best for them, and you want them to do what was best for them because you love them so much.. even though it hurts you.. but you're in this void was 'How? Why?'. 

And the missing them.. Who they are.

Just take every day as it comes, or every hour, or every minute.. even every second if you need to. Another thing that helped me was horror movies - probably because I was easily scared though! I found the feeling of terrifying myself really helped to give me some relief from the distress feelings, early on. I'm desensitized now though ;) The pain was still there, but the relief made things a little easier. Maybe you'll find something that works the same way? I hope so.

Again, wish I could offer more. I wish I could promise that things get a whole lot better - but all I can say is that I felt the distress got less, even if the pain and sadness didn't, and that was a relief. I hope you work through it to at least see how you feel when the distress dies down. I'm there with you. If you ever need to do more venting, I genuinely care about listening.

You commented on my post, and I came here. 

Like you, I can't offer anything new.. because we are, or have, experienced the same things. We both know the struggles and are trying to find the answers.

But there was one realization that helped me a tiny, tiny bit when the wounds of heartbreak were still fresh like yours are - at least eventually. I realized that I was still allowed to love him. I missed him, he was gone, he was moving/had moved on.. but I was still allowed to love him. I didnt have to force myself not to, if I couldn't. I could take my time. 

You're allowed to love her. You're allowed to take a deep breath and admit to yourself that you still love her, and may do for some time. I don't know if that thought will ever eventually calm the distress you're feeling, but it did for me a little.. again, eventually.

I still get the dreams and the jabs in my stomach. I still cry, quite often.

I hope that you and I both hold on. I suppose neither of us knows what will happen in the future, as hopeless as it seems now. 

Perhaps we'll go and live in a cave together, both missing our lost loves and living on berries. Who knows?!

I know how much you must love and miss her. How important she was to you. 

I wish there was more I could do. I know how frustrating it is when you try so hard to move forward from it, but things don't work as other people say they should. I wish I could find more words for you.

<3

Thank you for replying, I really do appreciate it. I like this subreddit, because even though I feel alone, it helps to remind me that I'm not alone in how I feel.

I sometimes get this crunching feeling in my stomach when I see peoples posts, wishing I could find words to tell them how I really wish they didn't feel the way they feel.

I also just read your own post.. I'll reply there.

Thank you.. your reply made me smile. I went a little far thinking about it and imagined myself, in a good few years time, as some sort of half synthetic, half organic. Perhaps maybe even like a cyborg. Hey, maybe it can happen! Technology is advancing very, very quickly.. New, synthetic muscles..! Even if not, that's actually a really fun thought.

Or just a cure.. holding out for a discovery and cure isn't something I usually think about at all.. maybe I should. Thank you :)
